[CW note] From the CryptoWeeklies video of 26 September 2026.

[2026-09-26_HBAR]  
Video Title: Hedera $HBAR Analysis 📊  
Video ID: q0V5Ct2xMgY  
Hedera (HBAR) | Class: CRYPTO  

    Current Structure:  
    • Current price sits just above the regression‑based fair value at 9 cents, with the 90‑day ROI at 32% and a composite risk score of 30.  
    • The SMA structure shows the price hovering near the 9‑cent fair‑value band, while the move consistency and impact score remain solid.  
    • Social sentiment has risen from the low‑20s to a current risk index of 39 out of 100, and the narrative cloud indicates active discussion over the past week.  

    Macro Quantitative Risk:  
    • TWAP baseline aligns closely with the 9‑cent fair value; the price is slightly above this level, placing it in risk level 1 and having touched risk levels 2‑3 in August 2026.  
    • Regression fair‑value bands suggest a 6% premium versus the price, while the TWAP model indicates a 22% discount, keeping HBAR in an accumulation zone.  
    • The 400‑day bear‑market cycle is 86‑87% complete, implying a near‑completion of the current bearish phase.  

    Downside & Upside Targets:  
    • Machine‑learning forecasts project a base case of 6‑11 cents over the next 10 weeks, a bull case of 16 cents, and a prolonged euphoria scenario reaching 28 cents.  
    • Panic‑drawdown floors are anchored at risk level 1, with non‑panic support around risk level 2‑3.  
    • Macro moving‑average support remains near the 9‑cent fair value, while cycle bull targets project a 8x‑10x upside to 71‑96 cents by late 2029.

[CW note] From the CryptoWeeklies video of 12 August 2026.

[2026-08-12_HBAR]  
Video Title: Hedera Network Growth: Is This the Hidden Gem of the Cycle?  
Video ID: RFWJV0eeaSk  
Hedera Network (HBAR) | Class: CRYPTO  

    Current Structure:  
    • HBAR trades at 6¢, a 50% discount to its time‑weighted average price (TWAP) of 12¢.  
    • The 90‑day return is a steep -30%, composite risk sits at ~30%, and relative momentum is below median while risk exceeds median.  
    • Trend quality remains decent; the asset is in a value‑trap zone with a risk level of 1 (out of 100) after previously peaking at risk level 6 during the 2025 euphoria.  
    • The price has moved from a purple line (TWAP) to a 50% discount, indicating a potential bottoming area where capitulation often occurs.  

    Macro Quantitative Risk:  
    • TWAP baseline is 12¢ with a gravity risk of 3/100, placing HBAR in a low‑risk zone but still above the 95th percentile band.  
    • Regression fair‑value bands show the current price sits in the middle of the 95th percentile zone, suggesting the machine‑learning forecast is within two standard deviations.  
    • The 68% base case projects a floor at 4¢, while the 10‑week horizon indicates a potential counter‑trend rally to 11¢.  
    • Accumulation distribution analysis places the asset in the accumulation territory with a risk zone of ~17%, and Bitcoin seasonality is currently favorable.  

    Downside & Upside Targets:  
    • Bottom estimate: 4¢ (10‑week low).  
    • Counter‑trend rally target: 11¢ (bull case).  
    • Base case range: 6–6.5¢.  
    • Euphoria target: 40¢, roughly 10× the bottom, derived from the 10‑x multiple from the 4¢ floor.  
    • The 95th percentile channel indicates that any price move beyond the current 6¢ level would be statistically rare, reinforcing the upside potential while keeping downside risk bounded at the 4¢ floor.
